summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various integration efforts, including updates to the Spark Community Sync and proposals for enhancing the REST specification. Key topics include the clarification of Avro schema for partition transforms, support for repartitioning old data files, and the introduction of finer-grained read restrictions.
highlights: Iceberg Spark Community Sync notes detail integration efforts and bug fixes
Discussion on clarifying Avro schema for 'day' partition transform fields
Proposal for adding support for repartitioning old partition spec data files
Introduction of 'ReadRestrictions' for fine-grained access policies
